advice: reports/plans/2026-11-05_advice_e98-neuron-r-FABLE.md (option A, with the lead's overrides in the plan)
labels: construction labels only, marked assumed: reuse = built to reuse something W0 does, new = built to teach something new (experiments/method_table/results/table.json .rows[].truth.how = 'only by assumption'; e62's copy side is the one causal check, unsettled)

settings.unit: log-odds of the target at the answer position (steering.logodds_at), mean over all held-out read windows of the task, as VPD's r
settings.gain_floor_source: VPD's MIN_GAIN, src/commute/local_faith.py:187: shares are not scored below a target gain of 1 log-odds
settings.p_learn_source: keydep.P_LEARN (src/commute/keydep.py:27), E12's learned rule; applied to key -> value tasks only. E53's next-token tasks have no learned level (lowercase's mean P(target) is about 0.006: T1 -5.08 log-odds, performed_anchor read.json lowercase/s0/step300), so the filter would empty that row by construction; they are filtered on the gain floor alone
settings.min_gap_source: E51/E52's separation rule, src/commute/elicit.py separation; experiments/method_table/build.py e51
settings.grid_end_note: k = 12288 patches Ah on every neuron, the same values the r_half cell's forward computes; expected 0 to float64 summation order

stage0.order: after the sha256, before any state of the rows is read; a miss writes, logs FAIL and exits 1
stage0.identity_source: E63's filed identity_tol on the same kind of patch; E63 measured 0 exactly on every task (experiments/neuron_sparsity/results/stage0.json identity/*)
stage0.w0: zero update on every task: every cell (T1, L00, L01, L10, L11, Lh) equals T0, max |difference| <= identity_tol; expected 0 exactly
stage0.band: the bar for the controls' exact zeros: max(identity_tol, band_multiple x the largest W0 deviation measured first in this stage)
stage0.e56_source: r_n in log P on the scoring half against experiments/keydependent_patch/results/job1.json .states.<n>.b2_shares['12288'] (elicit_s0 0.93685, cipher_s0 0.68531); E63's window path matched it within 9.4e-8 and 1.9e-8 (neuron_sparsity stage0.json e56/*), so 1e-5 is about 100 times that
stage0.do_nothing: code_step10 (E36's code fine-tune, regating_table/large) read on the two tasks: |G| < gain_floor, so every share is undefined and no rule can score it; |G| >= gain_floor stops the job (the floor would not tell a do-nothing from a change)

controls.recipe: keydep.finetune (src/commute/keydep.py:100-104): E54's elicit task (keydependent_elicit/large/windows_elicit.pt), arm A, Adam at anchors.FT_LR 3e-5, batch 32, clip 1, kl_lambda 1, 300 steps, read at keydep.scored_step (first of 10, 30, 100, 300 with held-out P >= 0.5), seed 0; one change: finetune.ArmAConfig.matrices
controls.cfc_attn: c_fc and the four attention projections of every block (16 matrices), down_proj at W0: readable (|G| >= gain_floor), |d_n numerator| <= band and |i_n numerator| <= band (O1 = O0, so both are the identity forward)
controls.down_only: down_proj of every block (8 matrices): readable, d_n > r_n (share), |e_n numerator| <= band (attention unchanged) and |r_half - r_n| numerators <= band (c_fc unchanged, so Ah = A1)

stage0.e56_reproduction: elicit_s0 and cipher_s0 (E54 seeds 0): within e56_tol

e54_own.vpd_r: elicit 0.76-0.77 vs cipher 0.24-0.27 (five seeds; seeds 2-4 of the own-step cipher were not saved)

not_run_rows.e58_rank1_96: only rank1_s0_step30 is on disk (open_pair/large/amend3); Amendment 4's seeds 1-2 and the three 96-key ciphers were never saved (amend4.py docstring: 'No weights are saved')
not_run_rows.e58_elicit_shuffle: only elicit_s0_step30 is on disk; the shuffle's states were never saved
not_run_rows.e54_own cipher seeds 2-4: cipher_own_s2-s4 were read by E56 and not saved (keydependent_patch/results/job2.json has no sha256 for them)

P1.claim: The headline neuron r (r_half: both MLP matrices W0's, only the MLP input changed) is not a kind reader: on the rows where VPD's r separates, it separates reuse-higher on fewer than half of the readable rows.
P1.rule: per row, elicit.separation(reuse, new, min_gap) on scored states (gain >= gain_floor; key -> value tasks also P(target) >= p_learn); 'unreadable' under two scored per side; pass iff 2 x (rows reading a_higher) < (readable rows) with readable rows >= min_rows, fail if not, unreadable under min_rows
P1.expected: pass; lean: open_pair_c3 unreadable (its ciphers sit at held-out P 0.32-0.45 at the read step: open_pair run.json, open_pair_instruments seeds.json .ft.p_heldout), so 3 readable rows and at most 1 may separate
P1.blind_to: where the gain is carried is not whether it is new: a reused mechanism and a new one can both run through re-fired neurons (E56: the full-width share rose 0.69 to 0.96 with training); relays (an MLP after a changed head re-fires with nothing of its own changed)
P1.positive_control: control/down_only reads r_half = r_n exactly and below d_n; control/cfc_attn reads d_n = i_n = 0
P1.noise_floor: the larger within-kind seed range of each row (E51's rule); numerical floor the W0 reading (expected 0)

P1r.claim: The full-width r_n cell (E52/E56's patch) is not a kind reader either, by the same rule on the same rows.
P1r.expected: pass; lean from E52 and E56 in log P: e46 reversed (copy lower), e54_own none (0.93-0.94 vs 0.95-0.97)
P1r.blind_to: as P1, and it also counts c_fc's own change as re-firing

P2.claim: Copy-type gains sit partly outside the MLP: e_n (attention's change, MLP outputs held at the state's) is higher on the reuse side on every readable row of the four.
P2.rule: a row with any scored state whose |i_n| > unstable_i reads 'cells_unstable', no verdict; otherwise elicit.separation(reuse, new, min_gap) on e_n, signed; pass iff every readable row reads a_higher with readable rows >= min_rows, fail if one does not, unreadable under min_rows
P2.expected: pass; lean: open_pair_c3_copy unreadable by the same P filter as P1
P2.blind_to: which attention change: e_n lumps every head and the four projections; an MLP-side mechanism that reads the changed residual through W0's c_fc counts in r_half, not e_n
P2.positive_control: control/down_only reads e_n = 0 exactly (attention untouched); control/cfc_attn's e_n is what its attention change carries (reported)

P3.claim: Go/no-go for the interpretation step (not in this job): the smallest shared neuron set carrying half the r_half cell is small only on lowercase.
P3.reading: k_half: per scored state, neurons ranked once by the sum over windows and positions of W0's gradient x (Ah - A0); the first grid k whose patch (Ah on the top k, A0 elsewhere) reaches half the r_half numerator; none ('no carrying set') when the r_half share <= carry_floor or its numerator <= 0
P3.rule: fail if a defined lowercase k_half > low_max or any other defined k_half <= other_min_exclusive; otherwise pass if both groups have a defined state, else unreadable
P3.expected: pass; E63's per-window ranking needed about 15 neurons for half on lowercase, about 110 on the broad cipher, 240 and 470 on the key -> value pair (reports/analyses/2026-11-02_analysis_e63-neuron-sparsity.md:191,214); a shared ranking needs more than a per-window one (E56: 4096)
P3.blind_to: the ranking is first-order and read on the same windows it is chosen on (in-sample); sufficiency of a set, not necessity; counts across tasks of different lengths (41 against 127 tokens) are not like for like
P3.positive_control: none of known size here; E63's 16-neuron built update is the nearest (C1 4); the k = 12288 end equals the r_half cell (grid_end_tol, checked per state)
